purpose: Test the frozen flooded-resonator frequency prior against traceable marine, biological, cryogenic, engineered and survey-source controls using exact numeric matching before any target interpretation.

match_classes.E0_EXACT_CENTER: Published/measured discrete frequency equals 520.4081632653061 Hz within +/-0.001 Hz.
match_classes.E1_EXACT_520: Published/measured/physically derived discrete value equals exactly 520.000 Hz; this is a rounded-center near-hit, not an exact model-center hit.
match_classes.E2_NOMINAL_DISCRETE: Discrete published/measured value lies inside 511.6618075801749-529.1545189504374 Hz.
match_classes.E3_CTD_ONLY: Discrete value lies outside nominal band but inside 504.8396501457726-543.265306122449 Hz.
match_classes.E4_BAND_OVERLAP_ONLY: A reported source/signal band contains the prior, but no discrete peak/line at the center is established.
match_classes.E5_NO_MATCH: Reported discrete value or entire band does not reach the CTD envelope.

E0_exact_center_hits.boundary: This is not proof that no such frequency exists anywhere; it means no traceable exact-center hit was verified in this pass.

strongest_exact_520_hits.geography: Scotia Sea / near South Georgia, South Atlantic-Southern Ocean sector
strongest_exact_520_hits.source_fact: Example harmonic tremor has 40 Hz fundamental, 40 Hz overtone spacing, and as many as 15 overtones visible.
strongest_exact_520_hits.derivation: 13th harmonic = 40 Hz * 13 = 520 Hz; equivalently the 12th overtone above the 40 Hz fundamental.
provenance: Dziak et al. 2013 Oceanography 'Life and death sounds of Iceberg A53a': https://tos.org/oceanography/assets/docs/26-2_dziak.pdf

strongest_exact_520_hits.geography: anechoic underwater tank experiment, Harbin Engineering University, China
strongest_exact_520_hits.additional_fact: Experimentally measured in-water resonance 520 Hz; corresponding TVR reported 135.4 dB at 520 Hz. FE model predicted 510 Hz.
strongest_exact_520_hits.provenance: Zhou et al., Sensors 2018, DOI 10.3390/s18072102, https://www.mdpi.com/1424-8220/18/7/2102

nominal_band_discrete_hits.reported_context: mean fundamental frequency for mature Atlantic croaker in laboratory measurements, reported with +/-71 Hz SD
nominal_band_discrete_hits.provenance: East Carolina University thesis dataset surfaced in exact-frequency audit; Atlantic croaker Micropogonias undulatus.

nominal_band_discrete_hits.note: The same device's FE design predicted 510 Hz, while measured in-water resonance shifted to 520 Hz.

atlantic_survey_source_overlap.provenance: IODP Leg 208 site-survey methods: water gun 0.16 L, 200-1600 Hz; https://www-odp.tamu.edu/publications/208_SR/204/204_3.htm

existing_cousteau_controls_reclassified_.reason: Broad biological band covers center; no exact stable 520.408163 Hz line established.
Broad/harmonic content can cross the prior; no exact model-center line established.
Resonance is size/depth/species dependent; no single universal exact center frequency.
Published upper edge 500 Hz is 4.8396501457726 Hz below frozen CTD lower edge.

semantic_exclusions: A 512 Hz instrument sampling rate is not an acoustic signal frequency and is not counted as a hit.
A 520 Hz high-pass filter breakpoint is not a source or target resonance and is not counted as a hit.
A broadband source containing 520.408163 Hz is not an exact spectral peak unless a calibrated spectrum shows a discrete feature there.
A frequency match without X(f) separation, phase, Q/linewidth, modal spacing, ringdown and geodetic repeat is not target identification.
